Name: Joja Community Development Form Re-Skin
Author: DukeOfEichenwalde
Description:
Replaces the Joja Community Development Form with a neater, slightly easier to read version, in black 8 pt. Times New Roman (Roughly)


[left]﻿In order to install this sprite edit you will need to:
[list=1]
[*]Extract the files from the .zip folder
[*]take the Content folder, and copy - paste it into your main Stardew Valley folder

[*]If and when asked to replace files, select replace
[*]The sprite edit is now installed, Enjoy!
[/list][/left]
